mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS (USER_ID, DELIVERY_DATE, TOTAL_PRICE, RECIPIENT_NAME, SHIPPING_ADDRESS, SHIPPING_ZIPCODE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deliveryDate}, #{totalPrice}, #{recipientName}, #{address}, #{zipcode})

mapper.sql: SELECT ORDER_ID, ORDER_DATE, DELIVERY_DATE, TOTAL_PRICE, RECIPIENT_NAME, SHIPPING_ADDRESS FROM ORDERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC, ORDER_ID DESC
mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_DATE, o.DELIVERY_DATE, o.TOTAL_PRICE, o.RECIPIENT_NAME, o.SHIPPING_ADDRESS, oi.ITEM_ID, oi.PRODUCT_ID, oi.QUANTITY, oi.PRICE, p.PRODUCT_NAME FROM ORDERS o LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEMS oi ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = oi.PRODUCT_ID WHERE o.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND o.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY oi.ITEM_ID
